scripts.check: concurrently --group "node scripts/cargo.mjs fmt --check" "node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings" "node scripts/cargo.mjs run --locked -- check" "node tools.mjs run actionlint"
scripts.fix: concurrently -m 1 --group "node scripts/cargo.mjs clippy --locked --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged --all-targets" "node scripts/cargo.mjs fmt" "node scripts/cargo.mjs run --locked -- fix"
scripts.unit: node scripts/cargo.mjs test --locked --lib --test spacing && node scripts/cargo.mjs test --locked --doc
